steps.title: This is Choreo
steps.say: Choreo plans **autonomous paths**: where the robot should drive, and how fast it's allowed to go. It works out the quickest route your robot can really follow.

steps.title: Paths
steps.say: Each path is one trajectory, like "leave the start line and pick up a game piece". The list of them lives here.

steps.title: Add a path
steps.say: The **+** makes a new, empty path.

steps.title: Pose waypoint
steps.say: Waypoints are the points the path goes through. A **pose waypoint** pins both where the robot is and which way it's facing. Use one for the start and the end.

steps.title: Translation waypoint
steps.say: A **translation waypoint** only pins where the robot is, and lets Choreo pick the heading. Use these for points in the middle.

steps.title: The field
steps.say: With a waypoint tool picked, **click on the field** to drop a waypoint there. Drag it to move it.

steps.title: Constraints
steps.say: These tools add **constraints**: rules the path has to obey, like a top speed between two waypoints, or a zone the robot must stay out of.

steps.title: Event markers
steps.say: An **event marker** says "do something here", like start the intake halfway along the path. Your robot code listens for its name.

steps.title: Features
steps.say: Everything on the current path is listed here: waypoints, constraints and markers. Click one to edit its exact numbers.

steps.title: Generate
steps.say: When the waypoints are where you want them, **Generate** works out the trajectory: the fastest path that goes through every waypoint and obeys every constraint. Change anything and generate again.
